name: metamask-tooling
description: MetaMask recipe tooling: the mm-harness runner and the Perps recipe library. Each slot edits its tooling repository and proves changes on its own Mobile checkout, simulator and Metro port.
action_sheet:
metamask-tooling registered. Register both projects: metamask-recipe-perps-farm runs the shared tooling in metamask-harness-farm.
  Provision each slot's own Mobile fixture once, in this order:
  1. git clone git@github.com:MetaMask/metamask-mobile.git <slot repo parent>/<mmh-mobile|mmrp-mobile>
  2. Copy the approved private Mobile runtime environment into that checkout on the node (never into Git or the pack)
  3. Run the slot actions: Install owned Mobile dependencies, Install Mobile dev client
  4. Save the approved testnet wallet (from projects/metamask-harness-farm/fixtures/runtime/wallet-fixture.json.sample) as <owned Mobile checkout>/temp/recipe/private/wallet-fixture.json (mode 600)
  5. Boot the slot's dev-server resource
  6. Run Apply approved testnet wallet fixture once
  The pool env must define MM_HARNESS_PACKAGE_ROOT, METAMASK_PERPS_LIBRARY_ROOT, FARMSLOT_NODE22_BIN and MOBILE_NODE_BIN; slot repo paths must be absolute.
